analysis_refs.heading: 2. Scope
analysis_refs.text:
Not in the first release: previews/loans, Standard Ebooks, DIKSHA/NCERT, CORE,
HAL, Zenodo, bioRxiv/medRxiv as live sources (show "Not connected yet" if
listed), embedded readers, downloads proxied through our server, accounts.

analysis_refs.heading: 2. Twenty categories and how to find candidates for each
analysis_refs.text: | C04 Textbooks and scholarly books/chapters | DOAB publisher records, OAPEN, Open Textbook Library, open university presses and OER collections | NCERT, university presses, e-PG Pathshala, open course-text projects and state textbook bodies | Official exports/OAI-PMH plus bounded local search, or supported API; edition/chapter identity and per-book access |

analysis_refs.text: | NCERT | Official catalog is known from the discovery playbook | Catalog request returned HTTP 503 here. No current machine-search or metadata route was demonstrated in this batch. Revisit supported feeds/exports; this is not a claim of source-wide downtime. |

analysis_refs.heading: C04. Textbooks and scholarly books/chapters
analysis_refs.text:
**India route.** Investigate [NCERT's textbook catalog](https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php),
state textbook bodies, university presses and e-PG Pathshala-linked institutions.
Start with official institution lists, then find their publication catalogs and
terms. An NCERT/state-board website with downloadable books is a candidate, not
evidence of an available external search API. Treat school medium, syllabus and
academic year as scope fields, not merely title keywords.

analysis_refs.heading: Evidence boundaries and next handoff
analysis_refs.text:
Documentation opens succeeded for IBBY, Parag, Book Dash, Gutenberg, OTL, DOAB,
Project Madurai, LibriVox, DAISY and NLS during this planning review. The research
tool returned HTTP 402 for StoryWeaver's open-content page, 502 for NCERT's
textbook page and 403 for DPLA's API page. Sugamya redirected to its current domain
but exposed no readable content to the tool. These observations establish neither
payment requirements nor source-wide outages. No credentials, source accounts,
outreach, bulk harvests or live query qualification probes were performed.

analysis_refs.heading: C09 — School lessons, curricula and examination resources
analysis_refs.text:
In India, start with [DIKSHA's discovery documentation](https://diksha.gov.in/help/getting-started/explore-diksha/),
which describes anonymous exploration and language/location filtering. Follow
the named content organizations to SCERTs, state boards and teacher-training
institutions. [NCERT's textbook portal](https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php) is a
lead for official textbook identities, alongside state textbook bodies and
examination-board archives. Treat textbooks shared with C04 as overlapping
category membership, not extra origins. The NCERT page returned 502 in this
review; its current retrieval route remains unverified.

analysis_refs.heading: C10 — Courses, lecture notes and teaching materials
analysis_refs.text:
For India, [SWAYAM's official overview](https://swayam.gov.in/about) identifies
national coordinators including NPTEL, UGC, CEC, NCERT, NIOS and IGNOU. Follow
coordinator → participating institution → official course/lesson catalog.
Record the producer institution and distribution platform separately. SWAYAM
describes free course learning and paid certification exams; the destination's
actual learning-access conditions still need review.

analysis_refs.heading: What the original checks established
analysis_refs.text:
- An Open Library work returned `ebook_access: public` alongside many Internet Archive identifiers. That does not identify which edition is freely readable.
- A HAL hit had a record URL and DOI but no `fileMain_s`: a repository hit is not necessarily full text.
- Zenodo returned a dataset; item-type filtering is essential.
- DOAJ supplied an older HTTP publisher URL; metadata alone does not prove the destination still works.
- Semantic Scholar returned **429**, and Gutendex timed out. Those checks do not establish general service availability.
- Some documentation URLs moved; corrected DOAB/OAPEN URLs appear in the catalog. Some sites returned only a JavaScript shell. NCERT/ERIC/OER Commons could not be fully inspected.

analysis_refs.heading: Credentials and implementation inputs
analysis_refs.text: Assumptions: global discovery with explicit language/country context; lawful public hosts; verified free source login is allowed (owner clarification 2026-11-01), labelled separately from anonymous reading; no full-text hosting, subscription purchases, or library-card integration. Existing India library coverage makes NCERT, DIKSHA, StoryWeaver and Shodhganga useful follow-ups, but their discovery integrations are not assumed ready.
